_comment: Menu icons this theme ships, rendered by .\scripts\render-icons.ps1 -Extension codex from the SVG sources in icons/. Paths are relative to this folder. Colors are the theme's ivory-soft, crimson-bright and gold tokens (src/tokens.css); re-run after changing them. The vector icons in src/Media.xaml are the same artwork: each Geometry is the d attribute(s) of the matching icons/<name>.svg, drawn as a 1.5 stroke on the 24 grid.

jobs._comment: Media.xaml maps Playnite's *Icon keys to these files.
